text_en: Now this is what you shall do to them to consecrate them, so that they may serve me as priests. Take one young bull and two rams without blemish,
text_cn: 你为祝圣他们作我的司祭，应行以下的事：牵一头公牛犊和两只无残疾的公绵羊，

text_en: and unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil. You shall make them of choice wheat flour.
text_cn: 准备无酵饼，油调的无酵糕，油抹的无酵薄饼：这些都应用细麦面做成，

text_en: You shall put them in one basket and bring them in the basket, and bring the bull and the two rams.
text_cn: 放在篮子内，连篮子也带来，并将那头公牛和两只绵羊牵来；

text_en: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and wash them with water.
text_cn: 然后领亚郎和他的儿子们到会幕门口，先叫他们沐浴，

text_en: Then you shall take the vestments, and put on Aaron the tunic and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastpiece, and gird him with the decorated band of the ephod;
text_cn: 以后拿过服装来，给亚郎穿上长衣，和挂厄弗得的无袖长袍，佩上厄弗得和胸牌，系上厄弗得带子，

text_en: and you shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy diadem on the turban.
text_cn: 把礼冠戴在他头上，将金牌系在礼冠上。

text_en: You shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head and anoint him.
text_cn: 再拿傅礼用的油倒在他头上，给他傅油。

text_en: Then you shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them,
text_cn: 以后叫他的儿子们前来，给他们穿上长衣，

text_en: and you shall gird them with sashes and tie headdresses on them; and the priesthood shall be theirs by a perpetual ordinance. You shall then ordain Aaron and his sons.
text_cn: 给他们束上腰带，缠上头巾；如此，使他们尽司祭之职，成为永远的规律：你要这样授与亚郎和他儿子们圣职。

text_en: You shall bring the bull in front of the tent of meeting. Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull,
text_cn: 以后把牛犊牵到会幕前边，亚郎和他的儿子们按手在牛犊头上。

text_en: and you shall slaughter the bull before the Lord , at the entrance of the tent of meeting,
text_cn: 你要在上主前，在会幕门口宰杀那牛犊，

text_en: and shall take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and all the rest of the blood you shall pour out at the base of the altar.
text_cn: 取些牛血，用你的手指抹在祭坛的各角上，把其余的血倒在祭坛脚前。

text_en: You shall take all the fat that covers the entrails, and the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, and turn them into smoke on the altar.
text_cn: 再取出遮盖内脏的一切脂肪、肝叶、两肾和两肾上的脂肪，放在祭坛上焚烧，使烟升起。

text_en: But the flesh of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside the camp; it is a sin offering.
text_cn: 牛犊的肉、皮和粪，应在营外用火焚化，因为这是赎罪祭。

text_en: Then you shall take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram,
text_cn: 以后把公绵羊牵来，亚郎和他的儿子们按手在羊头上。

text_en: and you shall slaughter the ram, and shall take its blood and dash it against all sides of the altar.
text_cn: 然后你宰杀这羊，取些羊血洒在祭坛周围。

text_en: Then you shall cut the ram into its parts, and wash its entrails and its legs, and put them with its parts and its head,
text_cn: 再把羊切成碎块，把内脏和腿洗净，放在肉块与羊头上，

text_en: and turn the whole ram into smoke on the altar; it is a burnt offering to the Lord ; it is a pleasing odor, an offering by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 在祭坛上焚烧整个公绵羊，使烟升起；这是献给上主的全燔祭，是中悦上主的馨香火祭。

text_en: You shall take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram,
text_cn: 再把另一只公绵羊牵来，亚郎和他的儿子们按手在羊头上。

text_en: and you shall slaughter the ram, and take some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron’s right ear and on the lobes of the right ears of his sons, and on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet, and dash the rest of the blood against all sides of the altar.
text_cn: 此后你宰杀这羊，取一些血，抹在亚郎和他儿子们的右耳垂上，抹在他们的右手拇指和右脚大趾上，其余的血洒在祭坛周围。

text_en: Then you shall take some of the blood that is on the altar, and some of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his vestments and on his sons and his sons’ vestments with him; then he and his vestments shall be holy, as well as his sons and his sons’ vestments.
text_cn: 以后取祭坛上的一点血和傅礼的油，洒在亚郎和他的衣服上，洒在他的儿子们和他们的衣服上：这样他和他的衣服，他们和他们的衣服，都成了圣的。

text_en: You shall also take the fat of the ram, the fat tail, the fat that covers the entrails, the appendage of the liver, the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of ordination),
text_cn: 再从公绵羊身上取出脂肪、肥尾，遮盖内脏的脂肪、肝叶，两肾和两肾上的脂肪以及右后腿，──因为这是授圣职时所献的公绵羊；

text_en: and one loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer, out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the Lord ;
text_cn: 然后从摆在上主前的无酵饼篮内，拿出一个圆饼，一个油调的饼，一个薄饼，

text_en: and you shall place all these on the palms of Aaron and on the palms of his sons, and raise them as an elevation offering before the Lord .
text_cn: 都放在亚郎和他儿子们手上，在上主前行奉献的摇礼；

text_en: Then you shall take them from their hands, and turn them into smoke on the altar on top of the burnt offering of pleasing odor before the Lord ; it is an offering by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 以后从他们手里接过来，在祭坛上按全燔祭的礼仪焚烧，使烟升起，作为上主悦纳的馨香：这是献给上主的火祭。

text_en: You shall take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s ordination and raise it as an elevation offering before the Lord ; and it shall be your portion.
text_cn: 以后你把亚郎受圣职时所献的公绵羊的胸部拿来，在上主前行奉献的摇礼，它就成了你的一分。

text_en: You shall consecrate the breast that was raised as an elevation offering and the thigh that was raised as an elevation offering from the ram of ordination, from that which belonged to Aaron and his sons.
text_cn: 你要声明摇过的胸，举过的腿，即亚郎和他的儿子们受圣职时，所摇过的公绵羊的胸和所举过的腿是圣的。

text_en: These things shall be a perpetual ordinance for Aaron and his sons from the Israelites, for this is an offering; and it shall be an offering by the Israelites from their sacrifice of offerings of well-being, their offering to the Lord .
text_cn: 这是亚郎和他的儿子们在以色列子民中永远所享的权力，因为是举过的祭品；举过的祭品，就是从以色列子民所献的和平祭品中，取出举献于上主的一部分。

text_en: The sacred vestments of Aaron shall be passed on to his sons after him; they shall be anointed in them and ordained in them.
text_cn: 亚郎的圣衣应传给他的子孙，他们穿上这些圣衣才能接受傅油，接受圣职。

text_en: The son who is priest in his place shall wear them seven days, when he comes into the tent of meeting to minister in the holy place.
text_cn: 他的子孙中凡接位当司祭，进会幕在圣所行礼的，应七天之久穿这些圣衣。

text_en: You shall take the ram of ordination, and boil its flesh in a holy place;
text_cn: 你要拿授圣职时所献的公绵羊，在圣处煮它的肉。

text_en: and Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the bread that is in the basket, at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
text_cn: 亚郎同他的儿子们须要在会幕门口吃这羊肉和篮中的饼，

text_en: They themselves shall eat the food by which atonement is made, to ordain and consecrate them, but no one else shall eat of them, because they are holy.
text_cn: 只许他们吃授圣职和祝圣他们时所献的赎罪祭品，外人不许吃，因为是圣物。

text_en: If any of the flesh for the ordination, or of the bread, remains until the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire; it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
text_cn: 授圣职时所献的祭肉和饼，若到早晨还有剩下的，应把剩下的用火焚化，不准再吃，因为是圣物。

text_en: Thus you shall do to Aaron and to his sons, just as I have commanded you; through seven days you shall ordain them.
text_cn: 你应照我吩咐你的，向亚郎和他的儿子们行这一切：七天之久给他们行授职典礼。

text_en: Also every day you shall offer a bull as a sin offering for atonement. Also you shall offer a sin offering for the altar, when you make atonement for it, and shall anoint it, to consecrate it.
text_cn: 每天你应献一只牛犊当赎罪祭，为赎罪；你应在祭坛上行赎罪祭，使祭坛洁净，而且要给祭坛傅油，使之为圣。

text_en: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and consecrate it, and the altar shall be most holy; whatever touches the altar shall become holy.
text_cn: 要七天之久为祭坛行洁净礼，使之为圣：如此祭坛就成了至圣的；凡触摸祭坛的，也成为圣的。

text_en: Now this is what you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old regularly each day.
text_cn: 你每天应照常在祭坛上奉献两只一岁的羔羊：

text_en: One lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer in the evening;
text_cn: 早晨献一只，傍晚献一只。

text_en: and with the first lamb one-tenth of a measure of choice flour mixed with one-fourth of a hin of beaten oil, and one-fourth of a hin of wine for a drink offering.
text_cn: 与头一只羊同献的，还有十分之一‘厄法’细面，调和上四分之一‘辛’榨得的油，和四分之一‘辛’的酒作奠祭。

text_en: And the other lamb you shall offer in the evening, and shall offer with it a grain offering and its drink offering, as in the morning, for a pleasing odor, an offering by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 与傍晚那一只同献的，如早晨的素祭和奠祭一样，作为上主悦纳的一种馨香的火祭。

text_en: It shall be a regular burnt offering throughout your generations at the entrance of the tent of meeting before the Lord , where I will meet with you, to speak to you there.
text_cn: 这是你们世世代代，在会幕门口，在上主前应不断献的全燔祭；我要在那里与你会晤，在那里向你讲话。

text_en: I will meet with the Israelites there, and it shall be sanctified by my glory;
text_cn: 我也要在那里与以色列子民会晤，此地要因我的光荣被尊为圣。

text_en: I will consecrate the tent of meeting and the altar; Aaron also and his sons I will consecrate, to serve me as priests.
text_cn: 我要祝圣会幕和祭坛，也要祝圣亚郎和他的儿子们，使他们成为我的司祭。

text_en: I will dwell among the Israelites, and I will be their God.
text_cn: 我要住在以色列子民中，作他们的天主。

text_en: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt that I might dwell among them; I am the Lord their God.
text_cn: 他们要承认我上主是他们的天主，领他们出离了埃及地，为住在他们中间：我上主是他们的天主。
